assessment.improvement: V81 is the strongest candidate: 64/64 sealed, 21/24 fresh64 (V79.6 level), 28/28 stock actions, E12_A/B clean. The rank-32 balanced mix restored the action/status behavior that V80 lost while keeping the curriculum gains.
publication_blockers: Raw V58_S13_B used the quoted public destination instead of the authorized private home; the guarded path canonicalizes it, bare weights would not.
Raw V58_S16_B ignores a supplied recall query; the new canonical_recall guard fixes it.
Raw E03_A derails on the tape/strip arithmetic case; the guarded path clears the action/status/interval checks but no arithmetic guard covers E03_A.
The base is Qwen2.5-VL-3B under the Qwen Research License (non-commercial); commercial publication needs Alibaba permission.
assessment.recommendation: Publish a guarded Lantern research preview, not bare V81 weights. The guarded path is clean on the sealed, fresh64, stock28 and E12/E13/S03 gates; disclose E03_A arithmetic and the non-commercial Qwen Research License. Do not claim general or commercial qualification.
